title: How Affistash uses AI to find and recruit affiliate partners: live demo
summary: Vic Giurgiu demos Affistash, an AI tool he built for affiliate managers that matches a company with publishers, creators and agencies, pulls contacts, and drafts outreach emails. He explains the design logic (one-input setup, feedback loop, manual plus automated search) and the pricing.

principles.text: Build for a specific niche by talking to practitioners first, then apply AI to make their job easier.
principles.quote: I started chatting with a few managers uh I tried to to do my best to discover the best idea and the best tool that can be built specifically for affiliate managers

principles.text: Reduce setup to one input (company data) and let the algorithm do the matching.
principles.quote: it's pretty easy you don't have to do anything manually other than inputting your company data

principles.text: Build a feedback loop so results improve with use: upvotes and downvotes teach the algorithm your fit.
principles.quote: since FS stash is based on AI and machine learning it obviously improves all over time so the more you use the platform the better results you will get

principles.text: AI-drafted outreach is a starting template; personalize per partner for better open and conversion rates.
principles.quote: I always recommend to people that use fist that you want to give your own personalization for the specific partner it obviously results in way better open race way better conversion race

principles.text: Offer both automated discovery and manual search so power users can widen their lead pool across channels.
principles.quote: this one is really helpful if you want to get even more leads than you you find with the automated search engine

principles.text: Price a lead-volume subscription cheaply for individuals, with a discounted annual plan and a pricier team tier.
principles.quote: you get 450 leads every month um at the price of 37 per month if you go with our annual plan
